programmes.t: The Best of the Carol Burnett Show
programmes.d: Paul Lynde and Nanette Fabray guest on the season finale, featuring an installment of 'As The Stomach Turns'

programmes.t: The Best of the Carol Burnett Show
programmes.d: Tonight's guests are Dyan Cannon and Paul Lynde! Lynde plays a smarmy insurance salesman
Jack Klugman is tonight's guest star! Jack plays a skeptical man annoyed by his sister-in-law's visiting date--a clairvoyant. Also: Carol, Tim and Harvey get a little work done in a very tiny office.
Don Rickles and Nanette Fabray guest star. In this episode, Fabray and Carol play a pair of expectant mothers, while Rickles is a shoe salesman one insult away from being fired. (Good luck, Don.)
Andy Griffith guests, retelling a familiar Aesop fable in his own inimitable fashion, then joins Carol for a down-home, countrified fairy tale musical production number: "Cinderellie."

programmes.t: The Best of The Ed Sullivan Show
programmes.d: Ed Sullivan presents Liza Minnelli, Gary Puckett and the Union Gap, Victor the Bear, John Davidson, and The Lennon Sisters.
Oscar nom’d for playing the title role in The Buddy Holly Story, Gary Busey has acted in over 150 movies. He talks about his early rocker days playing in a band at Disneyland and Knott’s Berry Farm.
Charles Grodin is Johnny’s guest, and “Welcome Back Kotter” star Gabe Kaplan pokes fun at his hometown Brooklyn and his high school days, upon which Kotter was based.

programmes.t: The Best of the Carol Burnett Show
programmes.d: Paul plays a shy man trying to gain confidence by listening to a self-help record, while Steve joins Carol and Harvey in 'The Putrified Forest.'
Jack Lemmon can't sit through his own movies and Maureen Murphy thinks writing jokes is as hard as having a baby. Johnny has something to say about his windshield wipers.
Jim Fowler, the host of “Mutual of Omaha’s Wild Kingdom,” brings an Indian Condor onto the show. Also featured is comedian Bob Nelson.
Tonight, Carol's guests are Barrie Chase and Larry Hovis! Chase provides a tuneful musical number, while Hovis plays "The Marriage Game", the latest in tacky game show entertainment.

programmes.t: The Best of the Carol Burnett Show
programmes.d: Tim contributes in sketches as the Lone Ranger and as a man who lives a dog's life, and Pat joins in on the latest 'Carol & Sis' installment.
Ed Begley Jr. discusses starting out in the business. Suzanne Pleshette and Michael Davis also appear.

programmes.t: The Best of the Dean Martin Show
programmes.d: Sketches and songs with Dean Martin and celebrity guests Ann-Margret and Bob Newhart.
Boisterous big mouth Martha Raye guests as Carol's unlikely cabinmate on a cruise. A "V.I.P." interview with Lynda Bird and a demonstration of E.S.P. only add to the fun.
Guests Mama Cass Elliot and Ken Berry offer up some musical numbers and a series of commercial parodies. Also, Zelda's TV-time interruptions lead to George imagining himself in a Western movie.
This episode is a real balancing act when expert balancer Ed Kennedy graces the stage along with comic legend Buddy Hackett and Breakfast Club star Ally Sheedy.
Kenneth Mars and John Byner guest star! Sketches include: Carol as an obsessed and oblivious soap opera fanatic, John enlisting Kenneth's coaching in a breakup, and the dreams of a married couple.

programmes.t: The Best of the Carol Burnett Show
programmes.d: Tim Conway is Carol's guest for a sketch where a betrothed couple elect to paint their future home--with messy results.
Catch a rack of iconic rumpled raincoats worn by 4-time Emmy winner Peter Falk in his detective show Columbo. Dallas star Victoria Principal chats about quitting booze and cigarettes.
Diahann Carroll and Carol perform a musical Halloween number that's all treat and no trick. 60s spiritualism is skewered when The Smothers Brothers drop by, and "Carol & Sis" dabble in astrology.
Hollywood leading man Gregory Peck dishes on WW2 hero General Douglas MacArthur, whom he played in the biopic, and the General’s overlooked sense of humor.
Guest star Bernadette Peters takes part in a sketch about a woman introducing her two best friends to each other. Also featured: another trip to the office with Mr. Tudball and Mrs. Wiggins.

Tonight, Tim and Carol spar over a late-night phone call, Tim tries to sell Vicki a vacuum cleaner, and the talented Carol and company demonstrate their utter lack of talent as musicians in a recital.
Tonight's episode features Harvey and Carol encountering a wishing well, and another installment of "The Family", with Eunice and Ed suffering through Mama's recuperation after an accident.

programmes.d: Ed Sullivan presents The Beach Boys, The Muppets, Richard Pryor, and Pearl Bailey.

programmes.t: The Best of the Carol Burnett Show
programmes.d: Sketches include an escaped convict seeking refuge in a diner, Carol and Vicki as robots made by John and Harvey, and the latest 'Carol & Sis.'

A nostalgic tribute to the legendary Ed Sullivan Show, which ran for 23 years. Hosted by The Smothers Brothers, the retrospective features historical clips from artists spanning the genres of novelty, comedy, pop music, and rock 'n' roll.

programmes.t: The Best of The Ed Sullivan Show
programmes.d: Ed Sullivan presents Hank Williams, Jr., Janet Blair, Otto Preminger, Billy Reed, Rene Levand, Jerry Vale, Lawrence and Carroll, and The Angels.
Carol's guests tonight are Garry Moore and Durward Kirby. Sketches include Carol as an increasingly-less dignified princess rehearsing a toast, and a peek inside the United States Safety Committee.

programmes.d: Sketches and songs with Dean Martin and celebrity guests Petula Clark, Don Rickles, Flip Wilson, Roy Rogers, and Dale Evans.
Ed Sullivan presents performances by The Supremes, The Jackson Five, Four Tops, James Brown, The Righteous Bros, and The Temptations.

programmes.d: Ed Sullivan presents The Animals, Jack Jones, The Volantes, Peter O'Toole, John Byner, and Joan Sutherland.
